# Reference history

The51 files listed by FREEZE-MANIFEST.json are unchanged copies of the independent source study and pre-observation material reference. Never rerun its archived generator to replace a failed golden.

CALIBRATED-WEB-01 was added AFTER observing the first window mismatch. It retains independent scalar experiments and heldout predictions/results, then changes only the declared finite Chromium image-opacity equation in a separate source-only generator. Original reference and failure remain. The solid-color and Canvas controls are diagnostics and do not all follow the image-opacity profile. See docs/FILE_TRANSMISSION_IMPLEMENTATION_QA.md for the scope and evidence. No native or first-measurement-blind claim applies to the amended reference.
